newsitem.title: USA: Russian Mars probe hits Pacific Ocean near Chile.
newsitem.headline: Russian Mars probe hits Pacific Ocean near Chile.

text.p: Russia's disabled Mars probe crashed down into the Pacific Ocean west of Chile at about 8:30 p.m. EST (0130 GMT), a spokesman for the U.S. Space Command said.
"It is out of space," the spokesman told Reuters. He said there were no additional details on the crash or its exact site, but it was clearly in "a broad ocean area somewhere west of Chile."
Australian officials said the probe landed between Easter Island and the Chilean capital of Santiago, and located the impact site at 31 degrees South, 96.3 degrees West.
